description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Fluid Flow and Mechanical Operations topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: fluid-particle-operations

facts.claim: Non-Newtonian fluids don't follow Newton's viscosity law: viscosity depends on shear

source.quote: a fluid that does not follow Newton's law of viscosity; that is, it has variable viscosity dependent on stress

facts.claim: Friction factor depends on Re and relative roughness ε/D

source.quote: Its value depends on the flow's Reynolds number Re and on the pipe's relative roughness ε / D

facts.claim: Darcy friction factor = 4 × Fanning friction factor

source.quote: by definition it is four times larger than the Fan

facts.claim: Volumetric meters measure volume flow; mass meters measure mass flow

source.quote: Volumetric flow meters quantity volumetric flow rate while mass flow meters quantify mass flow rates

facts.claim: A pump moves fluids by mechanical action

source.quote: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action

facts.claim: Pumps in series form a multi-stage pump

source.quote: When a pump contains two or more pump mechanisms with fluid being directed to flow through them in series, it is called a multi-stage pump

facts.claim: Size is reported as an equivalent sphere diameter

source.quote: transforms, in abstract way, the real particle shape into a simple and standardized shape, like a sphere

facts.claim: The drag coefficient quantifies drag in a fluid

source.quote: is a dimensionless quantity that is used to quantify the drag or resistance of an object in a fluid environment

facts.claim: Ergun equation gives pressure drop (friction factor) in packed beds

source.quote: The Ergun equation, derived by the Turkish chemical engineer Sabri Ergun in 1952, expresses the friction factor in a packed column

facts.claim: Related to the Kozeny–Carman equation for laminar flow

source.quote: its close relationship to the simpler Kozeny-Carman equation, which describes laminar flow of fluids across packed beds

facts.claim: Upward fluid flow makes a particle bed behave like a fluid

source.quote: a granular material is converted from a static solid-like state to a dynamic fluid-like state

facts.claim: It starts when drag balances the bed's weight (minimum fluidisation velocity)

source.quote: the aerodynamic drag forces will begin to counteract the gravitational forces

facts.claim: Particles settle out of suspension under gravity (or centrifugal force)

source.quote: particles in suspension settle out of the fluid in which they are entrained

facts.claim: Solids retained form a filter cake; liquid passing is filtrate

source.quote: Oversize particles may form a filter cake on top of the filter

facts.claim: Cyclones separate by vortex: heavy particles fling to the wall

source.quote: Larger (denser) particles in the rotating stream have too much inertia to follow the tight curve of the stream, and thus strike the outside wall

facts.claim: Comminution reduces particle size by crushing and grinding

source.quote: Comminution is the reduction of solid materials from one average particle size to a smaller average particle size

facts.claim: Energy laws relate energy to feed and product size (Kick, Rittinger, Bond)

source.quote: Kick's law, which related the energy to the sizes of the feed particles and the product particles

facts.claim: Screening separates particles by size alone

source.quote: A method of separating solid particles according to size alone is called screening
